summary.en: A job goes out along a beam and its result comes back along it: a star leaves the thread along an arc, drawing the beam behind it, and settles with its name and "Running"; later a bead of light runs back along the arc and the status turns to "Done". The beam stays, dim.
summary.zh: 一件活沿光束派出、结果沿同一条光束回来：星沿弧线离开主线、身后拉出光束，停下后标出名字和“进行中”；之后一粒光沿弧线跑回主线，状态变成“已完成”。光束留下，变暗。

fits: Long-running jobs the product keeps going in the background; a result that returns.
notFor: Results that are not tied to a job; more than about six beams at once.

intent.en: Show that what goes out comes back, along the same line.
intent.zh: 让人看到派出去的会沿同一条线回来。

content.en: A label (≤ 30 characters / 15 Chinese characters), a running and a done status.
content.zh: 一个名字（≤ 30 字符 / 15 个汉字），进行中与完成两个状态。

fits.zh: 产品在后台持续跑的活；结果回来的那一下。

notFor.zh: 和某件活无关的结果；同时超过六条左右的光束。

pairs.note: the scene that runs three of them
the short version: a task leaves as a star

en: The bead runs the same arc backwards: a straight return line reads as a second connection.
Cross-fade the status after the bead arrives (0.6–0.8 s), never before it.
zh: 光点沿同一条弧倒着跑：走直线回来会被看成第二条连接。
光点到了之后再交叉淡入状态（0.6–0.8 秒），不能提前。
